name: v2.3.0
body:
## What's Changed

## 🎉 See [Announcing Rspack 2.3](https://rspack.rs/blog/announcing-2-3) for more details.

### New Features 🎉
* feat: rename loader filter.code to codeFilter by @SyMind in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16184
* feat: integrate allocative snapshots and profiling skill into Rspack by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16046
* feat: support module.parser.javascript.dynamicUrl by @HashemKhalifa in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15933
* feat(watcher): expose watchpack times API on native and node watch file systems by @stormslowly in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15754
* feat(javascript): migrate parser to SWC Next by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16089
* feat: add loader codeFilter prefilter by @SyMind in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16073
* feat(create-rspack): display version in startup banner by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16167
* feat(rstest): add origin-aware import.meta.resolve hook by @9aoy in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16275
* feat(watch): support mixed ignored patterns by @Perfecto23 in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/13795
* feat: support es2026 target by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16311
* feat(cache): expose newCache statistics in Stats JSON by @ahabhgk in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16282
### Performance 🚀
* perf(size): box hot async entry futures to shrink binding size by @stormslowly in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16085
* perf(sources): avoid retaining serialized source maps by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16072
* perf(loader): schedule loader chains as execution units by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15401
* perf(loader-runner): read process.env.WASM once by @guru-irl in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16127
* perf: avoid creating untouched loader buildInfo by @guru-irl in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16077
* perf(resolver): prefer package directories in node_modules by @stormslowly in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16154
* perf(watch): lazily convert native watcher time info by @stormslowly in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16187
* perf(watcher): reuse directory analysis for unchanged subscriptions by @stormslowly in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16180
* perf(core): emit ESM export value descriptors when safe by @patrickkunka in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15936
* perf: reuse residual SplitChunks candidates in place by @JSerFeng in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16081
* perf(core): scan inline named exports linearly by @kdy1 in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16224
* perf(core): skip substring search when path has no fragment marker by @kdy1 in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16223
* perf(split-chunks): match built-in cache group conditions once per compilation by @guru-irl in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16129
* perf(sources): use slice iteration when parsing string arrays by @kdy1 in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16283
* perf(sources): read source map fields from the JSON tape by @kdy1 in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16297
* perf: avoid VLQ accumulation for single-sextet mapping values by @kdy1 in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16298
* perf(binding): preserve native source graphs during asset updates by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16207
### Bug Fixes 🐞
* fix: skip build dependency collection after fatal compilation errors by @ahabhgk in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16074
* fix(resolver): resolve tsconfig `extends` through the real path by @orgads in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15718
* fix(split-chunks): deduplicate remaining copies in named groups by @JSerFeng in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16075
* fix(css): align CSS Modules behavior with webpack css-loader fixtures by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15816
* fix(tracing): convert JavaScript trace nanoseconds to microseconds by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16103
* fix: stabilize module rendering order across platforms by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16100
* fix(binding): avoid shared property leak warnings on process exit by @SoonIter in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16117
* fix: use the module exports argument for the AMD exports dependency by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16122
* fix: respect module arguments in AMD code generation by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16148
* fix(mf): make deterministic IDs independent of project paths by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16152
* fix(watch): make node watch time info entries deterministic by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16126
* fix(javascript): reuse parser source type by @CPunisher in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16102
* fix: link import bindings inside define callbacks by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16159
* fix(javascript): respect block function scope by @CPunisher in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16162
* fix(css): localize type-first nested selectors by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16011
* fix(javascript): preserve legacy parser behavior by @CPunisher in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16164
* fix(lazy-compilation): avoid barrel reloads on activation by @JSerFeng in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16026
* fix(split-chunks): support minRemainingSize by @JSerFeng in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15594
* fix: release updated allocative crates to resolve napi feature mismatch by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16171
* fix(HMR): correct hot updated chunk path resolution in Node.js HMR by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16174
* fix(release): synchronize workspace versions and CLI peer dependencies by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16181
* fix: inherit splitChunks request limits in cache groups by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16191
* fix(css): calculate CSS module hashes from graph dependencies by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16120
* fix(core): preserve shorthand assignment keys in concatenation by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16205
* fix(cache): unify snapshot path matching and package lookup by @ahabhgk in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16194
* fix(javascript): correct loose equality evaluation for nullish values by @NaamuKim in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16141
* fix(lazy-compilation): avoid reposting active ids on dispose by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16200
* fix: allocative crate package names by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16212
* fix(mf): support consumes runtime without chunk loading by @LingyuCoder in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16209
* fix(mf): normalize single-item container share scopes by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16251
* fix(css): localize animation names before !important by @dajiaohuang in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16204
* fix(watcher): keep watching when unwatching a stale path fails by @sarankumar1325 in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16199
* fix(sri): generate integrity hashes for chunks that only contain extracted css by @ojj1123 in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15711
* fix: inherit sideEffects through nested package metadata by @JSerFeng in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15336
* fix(types): narrow EvalSourceMapDevToolPlugin options by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16265
* fix(css): keep media attribute of hot replaced stylesheets by @CyberAP in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16214
* fix(rsc): collect client components from all entry dependencies by @sarankumar1325 in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16254
* fix(watcher): invalidate on native watcher removals by @guru-irl in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16284
* fix(watcher): report a removed file once when it stays a dependency by @guru-irl in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16305
* fix: raise inherited SWC target cap to ES2024 by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16314
* fix(css): preserve stylesheet attributes and state during HMR by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16287
* fix: update named chunks when merging or removing chunks by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16312
* fix(watcher): preserve native event delivery while JavaScript is blocked by @ScriptedAlchemy in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16106
* fix: include module_id in chunk hashing by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16168
* fix(ci): update Dylint to 6.3.0 by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16332
### Refactor 🔨
* refactor(binding): retain DependencyRef in JavaScript wrappers by @SyMind in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16061
* refactor(sources): use a source-wide UTF-16 index and remove object pool by @SyMind in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16083
* refactor(javascript): remove redundant ESTree AST wrappers by @CPunisher in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16098
* refactor: reuse current module in dependency templates by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16149
* refactor(javascript): emit mangled destructuring keys as strings by @CPunisher in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16147
* refactor(cache): reuse persistent cache options for newCache by @ahabhgk in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16160
* refactor(css): share CSS module graph traversal by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16119
* refactor(css): query placeholders from compiled templates by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16169
* refactor: remove unused __rspack_esm_id export from module chunks by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16193
* refactor(binding): use registered symbols across Rust and JS by @SyMind in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16210
* refactor: remove dead code and unused parameters by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16217
* refactor: reuse modules and connections already in hand by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16197
* refactor: use SIMD UTF-16 length for dependency locations by @SyMind in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/15585
* refactor: reuse data already in hand instead of looking it up again by @hai-x in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16218
### Document 📖
* docs: update renamed crates in project architecture by @Jarvis636431 in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16087
* docs: add parallel loader section to loader guide by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16092
* docs: add memory diagnostics guide by @intellild in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16080
* docs: explain hot update manifest fields by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16114
* docs: clarify Rsdoctor capabilities and simplify setup guide by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16125

* docs: correct stats detail defaults by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16248
* docs: distinguish stats JSON and text defaults by @chenjiahan in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/rspack/pull/16249
